description: Values the code builds itself: computed values that sort the result of filter and slice, reverse the result of map, group a list into a fresh record (with an if or ??=), and reduce a list into a fresh record or Map (acc[k] = v, ||= then push, set); a nested immutable update that pushes onto a copied array; two textareas sized and classed by their handlers, through a template ref and through event.currentTarget, beside elements that bind a class and a style.
